# First-party variable-font fixture

RavetVariation.ttf is an authored primitive TrueType test asset generated by
`generate.py` with optional fontTools 4.62.1. It contains rectangles, an empty
space and two independently additive weight/width gvar axes, including advance
phantom-point deltas. No system, commercial or external font asset is used.
Source and generated bytes follow RAVET's GPL-3.0-only source licence.

Run `python3 generate.py` in this folder to reproduce the fixed-timestamp bytes.
The default `a` has advance500 and right edge480 font units. Weight100/900 adds
advance-50/+100 and right-edge-40/+80; width50/200 adds advance-100/+200 and
right-edge-100/+200. Each axis interpolates linearly independently around its
weight400/width100 default. The remaining glyphs use the same rectangle policy;
space varies width by half the width-axis advance and ignores weight. These
analytic coordinates and independent fontTools instancing provide the oracle;
RAVET/harfrust/read-fonts output is not used to calculate expected results.

The consumer sample maps A/m to the authored a rectangle and g/0 to b in the
cmap. These deliberate aliases exercise covered fixed sample text without
introducing external letterform assets; they do not claim realistic typography.
